svg.metadata: Coastline/territory: geoBoundaries gbOpen FRO ADM0, commit 9469f09, Sentinel-2 10m land cover (image year 2021), raster2polygon excluding water, processed by IMB; CC BY 4.0; https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09/releaseData/gbOpen/FRO/ADM0/geoBoundaries-FRO-ADM0.geojson . Principal-island footprints cross-checked against GSHHG high-resolution shoreline, broad scope against Natural Earth Admin-0, and Visit Faroe Islands 18-island maps. Inland lake Sørvágsvatn: © OpenStreetMap contributors, way 45676892, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright; retrieved 2026-11-07. WGS84; shared local equirectangular projection. 18 principal islands including Suðuroy plus coastal skerries retained. Inland raster holes filled as land; only verified lake geometry shown. Japanese map labels outlined using Noto Sans CJK (SIL Open Font License), independent of viewer fonts. Not for navigation.
